# Support

## How to get help

- **Documentation:** https://www.xfree.in/docs
- **Bug report:** open an issue using the Bug Report template
- **Feature idea:** open an issue using the Feature Request template
- **Security issue:** see [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md) — private reporting only

## Before you open an issue

1. Search [existing issues](https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/xfree/issues) — your
   question may already be answered.
2. For tool behavior, confirm whether the tool is **local** (browser) or
   **AI-backed** (server proxied). Local tools never upload your input.
3. Include exact steps, the URL, and sample input (without secrets).

## Community

- GitHub Discussions are preferred for "how do I…" and "should XFree support…"
  conversations.
- Keep it respectful — see [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Paid support

XFree.in is free and open source. There is no paid support tier. For enterprise
or integration questions, email contact@xfree.in.
